english.note: Use this for expressing pent-up feelings, especially when someone vents them at another person.
Use this for pouring out or venting emotions, anger, or abuse rather than for liquid.

examples.english: You shouldn't unload your anger on me.
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 lo2 ngo5 lai4 faat3 sit3

examples.english: Don’t pour your anger out on me.
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 lo2 ngo5 lei4 faat3 sit3 wo3
